segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Can I help you?

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Yes, I’ve just moved to this area with my wife and children and I’d like to know where we can all register with a doctor at a Health Centre.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Okay. Well, there’s Doctor Green at The Harvey Clinic. We always recommend her for babies, because she’s very good with them [[ ]] and she runs a special clinic.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh ... actually my youngest child is five, so that wouldn’t be any good for us.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Is there anywhere else I could try?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, the Eshcol Health Practice is the next one on my list [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: How do you spell that?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: E-S-H-C-O-L. And it’s Doctor Fuller, who has space on his list. The clinic only opened a year ago, so the facilities are all very modern.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That sounds good.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: And it’s particularly good if you’re busy during the day because they also do appointments in the evening [[ ]] . They’re closed on Saturday, though. The only other place on the list is the Health Centre on Shore Lane. You can register with Doctor Gormley, that’s G-O-R-M-L-E-Y [[ ]] . He’s new there, but the centre has a very good reputation.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Oh yes, I think I know the road. That would be the best one. Thanks. Could you tell me, will all their services be free?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Erm... there are usually some small charges that doctors make. Let me see what it says about the Shore Lane Centre. If you need to be vaccinated before any trips abroad, you won’t have to pay for this [ & 6]. Erm, what else? The sports injury treatment service operates on a paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service. Some health centres do offer alternative therapies like homeopathy as part of their pay-to-use service. Shore Lane are hoping to do this soon – I think they may start with acupuncture. And finally, if you need to prove you’re healthy or haven’t had any serious injuries before a new employer will accept you, you can get a free fitness check-up there [ & 6], but you’d most likely have to pay for insurance medicals though.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Okay, thanks.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: You might also be interested to know the Centre is running a pilot scheme of talks for patients. I’ve got the list here. Actually, they look very interesting.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: What sort of things?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Well, the first one’s about giving up smoking. It’s next week, the twenty-fifth of February, at 7 pm, and that’s in Room 4. It says the talk will stress the health benefits particularly for people with asthma or heart disease [[ ]] .

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: That sounds very interesting.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: There’s also a talk for families with children. It’s on Healthy Eating and takes place on the first of March at five o’clock.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Will that be at the Health Centre?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Erm, actually it’s at the primary school on Shore Lane [[ ]] . I imagine they’re inviting the parents of pupils there – it says here ‘all welcome’.

segments.speaker: MAN
segments.en: Mmm, I might go to that if I have time.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: There’s a couple of other talks – one giving advice about how to avoid injuries while doing exercise. It’s on the ninth of March.
